description: Agent loop settings shared by all three agents. Each agent's name and its own instructions are
in its folder's instructions.json (mcp/, pydantic/, vercel/).
max_tool_calls: the most tool calls the model may make while answering one prompt;
0 means no limit (a model stuck in a loop then runs until stopped with Ctrl+C).
A multi-step task (read a project, change it, build, open a pull request) needs 20 to 90.
max_repeated_calls: the most times in a row one prompt may make the same tool call (same tool,
same arguments); the next is not run, and the model is told its result will not change and to
answer. It stops a model stuck checking something only a person can change. 0 means no limit.
tool_retries: how many times the model may correct a call to one tool that was refused for
invalid arguments; past that the turn ends, keeping its results so far. Only the Pydantic Agent
uses it: MCPAgent and the Vercel Agent return the refusal to the model and rely on
max_repeated_calls.
memory_index: the agents' memory index (relative to the repository), loaded into their
instructions at start-up; the memory tool maintains it.
save_on_exit: when the user types exit in the interactive chat, first give the model one
turn to save what is worth remembering (the on_exit prompt in instructions.json); skipped
for a session with no tool call and a single exchange, and by Ctrl+C or a --prompt run.
skills_dir: the skills folder (relative to the repository): one <name>/SKILL.md per skill, whose
name and description are listed in the agents' instructions at start-up; the skill tool reads them.
out_of_tokens_retries: when a reply runs out of tokens (max_tokens in models.json), usually a
reasoning model thinking in circles, ask again this many times with the out_of_tokens prompt
(instructions.json), keeping the turn's tool results; 0 reports it at once.
thinking_dir: with -d, the thinking of a reply that ran out of tokens is saved in this folder
(relative to the repository) as thinking-<date>-<time>.log; empty saves nothing.
